facts.text: The hotel is steps from the BTS Skytrain Ratchathewi station and within walking distance of the Siam shopping district.

facts.text: The hotel was designed by French architect J + H Boiffils, with works of art, exotic furniture, soft shades and bold colors.

facts.text: Asian design accents feature in the rooms.
